name: Buy a T-shirt
task: Buy one black Medusa T-Shirt in size M and have it delivered to your home. Pay with whatever payment option the shop offers.

success.describe: an order placed with your email that contains SHIRT-M-BLACK
success.sql: select li.variant_sku from "order" o join order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.id join order_line_item li on li.id = oi.item_id where o.email = :'email' and o.created_at >= to_timestamp(:start)
